independence_declaration.statement: I (code-security-reviewer) authored no implementation in the reviewed scope (tools/gates, tools/agents, tools/source, CI workflow, agent definitions, analysis). My only writes are this record, its sidecars and my evidence under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/code-security/round-20/. I formed this verdict without reading any other round-20 review record.

checks_run.procedure: Confirm the frozen candidate before reviewing
checks_run.command: git rev-parse HEAD; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG0; git log --oneline a23c4d4..HEAD
checks_run.environment: repository working tree, agent shell sandbox
checks_run.expected: candidate.mjs prints sha256:ef3ec3f2...8ddaf; any commit after the freeze is metadata-only
checks_run.actual: HEAD ce6d9b6 ('freeze round-20 candidate, round-20 assignments'), which changes only assignments, the manifest and stages.json. The working tree recomputes sha256:ef3ec3f205ffdac3609c6f100cfb9900afb72f0e5bb381fbc5409eb1a8a8ddaf (91 files), and so does a fresh clone at a23c4d4.

checks_run.procedure: Review the full round-20 change set in scope
checks_run.command: git diff 0a652018..a23c4d41 -- tools .github .claude CLAUDE.md docs/delivery/threat-model.md docs/delivery/agent-protocol.md
checks_run.actual: 4 files: .claude/settings.json (git allow rules removed), threat-model.md residual 7, rules.mjs checkCandidate (+ gate source_commit existence check), validator.test.mjs (+1 test). tools/agents, tools/source, the CI workflow and the agent definitions are unchanged since the round-19 candidate I reviewed in full.

checks_run.procedure: Verify the corrected threat-model residual 7 (F-DG0-154) and re-assess F-DG0-149 and residual 8 at the corrected scope, by document and code review only (no /proc access)
checks_run.command: read docs/delivery/threat-model.md:57-61, tools/agents/agent_sandbox.py:127-160, tools/agents/guard-write.mjs:105-160, decisions.md D-033/D-036
checks_run.expected: residual 7 states uid 0 with only CAP_SETFCAP and no_new_privs, the uid-0 DAC-writable subset, host-global scope and the withdrawn shell claim; residual 8 is accurate
checks_run.actual: Residual 7 now states all of these, matching the bwrap args (--unshare-ipc only, --bind /proc /proc). The integrity conclusion is sound. Residual 8 (shared PID ns, private IPC ns, Landlock scope refusing /proc/<peer>/root|cwd and cross-run signals) is consistent with the code. Two stale sentences remain (agent_sandbox.py:149-151 read-only-shell comment; a '/proc/<peer>/sys' parenthetical), raised as Low F-DG0-157. F-DG0-149 is accepted as an observation.
